title: PHANGS-JWST GMC catalog (Bazzi+, 2026)

catnat.dat.note: 118.7 MiB, NOT the ~211 MB stated in the request

sandbox_reduction.why: consuming sandbox has 0 MB URL ingress; per-file ceiling 32 MiB, 64 MiB total
sandbox_reduction.selection_rule: Every row and every column of the source table is kept; the ONLY transformation is that each fixed-width field is cut at its exact ReadMe byte offset, whitespace-trimmed, and re-emitted as CSV with floats rounded to 8 significant figures (%.8g) except RAdeg/DEdeg at 10 significant figures (%.10g), with Galaxy/Env/fall/EdgeClouds copied verbatim as strings, then gzipped.
sandbox_reduction.byte_exact_alternative_rejected: xz -9e on catnat.dat extrapolates to ~46.7 MiB, over the 32 MiB per-file ceiling

fall_column.reading_A_true_selects: Description + Note (2): 'Use fall set to 1 to select the subset analyzed in the paper.'
fall_column.reading_B_true_excludes: byte-by-byte Explanations, both tables: 'Flag to exclude clouds according to our method, setting True excludes the clouds (f_all).'

structural_findings: catnat.dat covers 65 galaxies, cat30pc.dat covers 66 -- IC5332 is present at 30pc and ABSENT at native resolution, despite both being described as 66 galaxies.
catnat.dat has Env=0.0 on 3163 rows, a code absent from the ReadMe Note (G1) legend (which defines only 1.0-10.0). cat30pc.dat carries the [1/10] range constraint and has zero Env=0.0 rows.
CDS publishes these tables ONLY gzipped: .../catnat.dat and .../cat30pc.dat return HTTP 404 (283-byte HTML shell). Only the .gz paths exist.
The five Mass* and five SD* columns are the same measurement under five alpha_CO prescriptions -- correlated by construction, not independent evidence.
Masses derive from PAH 7.7um via a linear PAH->CO conversion, not CO detections; only 41% of PAH clouds have an ALMA CO counterpart.
